message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays that apply nationwide in Canada for 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and a holiday‑observed Monday or Friday.)

| Holiday | Observed Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|----------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday Jan 1, so the holiday is observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, New Brunswick, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** (Fri‑Mon) | Third Monday in February. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** (Fri‑Sun) | Federal holiday; no extra day off beyond the Friday itself. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | **May 20 – May 22** (Fri‑Mon) | Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** (Sat‑Mon) | Canada Day fell on Saturday Jul 1, so the holiday is observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** (Fri‑Mon) | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** (Fri‑Mon) | Second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** (Sat‑Mon) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday Nov 11, so the holiday is observed on Monday Nov 13. |
| **Christmas** | Monday Dec 25 | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** (Fri‑Mon) | Christmas Day fell on Monday. |

**What’s not a long weekend?**

- **Boxing Day** (Dec 26, 2023) falls on a Tuesday, so it does not create a long weekend.  
- Other provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in some provinces, Civic Holiday in Ontario, etc.) may create additional long weekends in specific provinces, but they are not federal holidays and therefore not listed here.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific long weekends or any other details, just let me know!
